assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. New WorldEngine JAPAN infrastructure reference artwork. Two input images are STYLE references only: Image1 approved Style B Bible calibration street governs grounded realism and soft lighting, Image2 Japan regional vehicles governs real proportions and simplified matte surface depth. Do NOT copy any characters, Chicago/US streets, badges, liveries or architecture. THREE EQUAL vertical panels side-by-side separated by narrow pale gutters: LEFT ground/street three-quarter near view, CENTRE aerial three-quarter of SAME infrastructure, RIGHT far regional view of SAME infrastructure at about 15–20% panel width. Preserve structure/topology across panels, reduce distant detail without changing physical scale. Grounded terrain, not floating toy/isometric slab. Rich Style B real proportions, smooth forms and smooth shading, broad matte surfaces, gentle contact/recess depth; no photographic textures or noisy asphalt/brick/grain, no dense individual foliage, no cartoon/faceted toy objects. Approved warm-neutral clear-afternoon sun #FFE8C6 40deg elevation/225azimuth, blue sky #73A5CC to #DBDCD1 soft clouds, fill #AEBCCA, shadows #7F8F99, +.35EV, no orange wash/purple shadows/rim outlines. All designs ORIGINAL GENERIC: NO logos, badges, brands, operator paint schemes, real murals, readable signage/letters/numbers, dogs, characters, people or animals. Very sparse generic unbadged vehicles only where requested, realistic wheelbase/cabin proportions, no signature grille. No labels, palette chips, dimensions or watermark in image; these will be supplied outside artwork. Japan left-hand roads, no US marking recipe.
